room_description.en: An elegant hotel dining room frozen in time. A large wooden door stands in the center, flanked by a chalkboard menu and a service note on the wall. To the left, a massive wine rack reaches the ceiling, while to the right, a mysterious service hatch sits embedded in the paneling. Several tables are set with aged tablecloths and distinct colored napkins—Red, Blue, and Gold—marking a strange order of service.
room_description.zh: 一间被时间凝固的优雅酒店餐厅。大木门位于中心，两侧是黑板菜单和墙上的服务说明。左侧是一个直达天花板的巨大酒架，右侧的镶板中嵌着一个神秘的传菜窗口。几张餐桌上铺着陈旧的桌布，并放着颜色各异的餐巾——红色、蓝色和金色——标记着某种奇怪的服务顺序。

story_fragment.en: The 'Service Order' note on the wall seems out of place for a luxury hotel. It's almost as if the staff were following a code rather than a menu.
story_fragment.zh: 墙上的“服务顺序”笔记对于一家豪华酒店来说似乎格格不入。就好像员工们遵循的是某种代码，而不是菜单。

clue_source.en: Each table has a brass number plate and a colored napkin. A wall sign says: 'Service Order: Red, Blue, Gold.'
clue_source.zh: 每张桌子都有一个黄铜桌号牌和彩色餐巾。墙上的告示写着：'服务顺序：红色、蓝色、金色。'

solution_steps.zh: 记录颜色：红色(4号桌)，蓝色(7号桌)，金色(2号桌)。

clue_source.en: Add the prices of the three specials on the chalkboard: $14, $28, $9.
clue_source.zh: 将黑板上三道特色菜的价格相加：$14, $28, $9。

solution_steps.en: Sum is 51. Enter into the kitchen hatch lock.
solution_steps.zh: 总和为51。在厨房传菜窗锁上输入。

clue_source.en: A locked cabinet in the wine rack area requires a 3-digit code.
clue_source.zh: 酒架区域的一个带锁柜子需要一个3位数的密码。

solution_steps.en: Enter '472' (from Table Tally) into the cabinet lock.
solution_steps.zh: 在柜子锁上输入'472'（来自餐桌统计）。

clue_source.en: Use the corkscrew to open the vintage bottle.
clue_source.zh: 使用开瓶器打开陈年酒瓶。

solution_steps.en: Select Corkscrew, then click Wine Bottle in inventory.
solution_steps.zh: 选择开瓶器，然后点击物品栏中的酒瓶。

final_action.en: Unlock the service door next to the fireplace.
